as_told.title: Kary Mullis woke in a shed and spoke with a being

plain: Kary Mullis, the scientist who invented PCR, a lab method for copying DNA that won him a Nobel Prize, is said to have had an encounter with an alien, waking up in a shed and speaking with some kind of being. Jesse Michels brings this up himself on more than one episode, once simply saying Mullis saw an alien and once calling it an abduction, while admitting he does not remember the exact details. He tells it to show that even a celebrated scientist reported such an experience.
